existing_native_receipts: For an existing receipt format, a selected original-source verifier must validate that original encoding and its referenced artifacts, then expose the same authenticated statement with the original byte binding and policy custody. A conversion cannot originate a new assertion or approve changed members. Newly authored shared receipts may use OriginalArtifactReceipt directly.
validation: Authenticate every original receipt under its selected issuer and predicate policy.
Match exact operation, scope and cut.
Read each exact original artifact and match SHA-256 and byte count.
Validate the selected source schema, derive members by approved pointers, reject missing and conflicting members.
Reject duplicate, missing or unexpected predicates. Validate the final complete input ABI before sealing.
Seal exact output bytes with receipt and artifact provenance and issuance-selection digest.
Project the sealed bytes through the existing checked projection.

recovery_variants.historical-publication: Require original canonical authorization, original closed bundle and observed publication receipt. Recover the immutable historical operation before deriving current obligations.
recovery_variants.native-unknown: Require the original operation and inspection observation, preserving Unknown until a proved commit or refusal.
recovery_variants.refusal: Require exact refusal past fact, phase, operation and intact native draft receipt if one exists.
recovery_variants.completion: Require original terminal journal receipt and both committed/replayed native and publication outcomes. Contradictions produce InvalidEvidence and trigger journal inspection.
recovery_variants.source-transition: Require original published snapshot and its observed selector receipt. Observe later current selection separately, retaining superseded historical snapshots.

selected_source_closure: The approved issuance selection qualifies every schema and verifier against exact source bytes through its reviewed source closure. A schema ref must resolve to that closure before it can validate an original. The operation input validator resolves the generated ABI from the same reviewed compilation.
inspection: Read-only candidate inspection may use a separately qualified observation selection which certifies current absence, pending disposition or unknown outcome from the actual source. Such a selection carries an inspection claim ceiling and authorizes no effect. Missing evidence cannot be invented merely to produce a ready plan.
